test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If (x + (1)/(x)) = (11)/(5), what is the value of (x³ + (1)/(x³))?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula: If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a

Here, a = 11/5

x³ + 1/x³ = (11/5)³ − 3 × (11/5)

x³ + 1/x³ = 1331/125 − 33/5 = (1331 − 825) / 125

x³ + 1/x³ = 506/125 = 4 6/125

**∴ The correct answer is 4 6/125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = 11/5

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Cubing both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = (11/5)³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × x × 1/x × (x + 1/x) = 1331/125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × 1 × 11/5 = 1331/125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 33/5 = 1331/125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 1331/125 − 33/5

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 1331/125 − (33 × 25) / (5 × 25)

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = (1331 − 825) / 125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 506/125 = 4 6/125

**∴ The correct answer is 4 6/125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Higher Power Algebraic Identities

If x + 1/x = a, the square relation is x² + 1/x² = a² − 2, and the fourth power relation is x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (a² − 2)² − 2.

Negative Form Algebraic Identities

If x − 1/x = a, the square relation is x² + 1/x² = a² + 2, and the cube relation is x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.
